fact.claim: Email-validated certificates need an action by the domain owner to be renewed: ACM sends renewal notices with a link, and after all domains are validated it issues the renewed certificate with the same ARN.
fact.question: Does an email-validated ACM certificate renew without anyone acting?

values.display: require an action by the domain owner
issues a renewed certificate with the same ARN

evidence.quote: Email-validated certificates require an action by the domain owner to be renewed. ACM begins sending renewal notices 45 days before expiration. These notices go to one or more of the domain's five common administrator addresses. The notifications contain a link that the domain owner can click for easy renewal. Once all listed domains are validated, ACM issues a renewed certificate with the same ARN.
evidence.title: Validate domain ownership for AWS Certificate Manager public certificates
